title: Let's cook together
titleJp: {一緒|いっしょ}に{作|つく}ろう

canDos.text: Suggest what to cook in casual Japanese and compare two options (which is quicker, which is better for you).
Read a simple recipe and put the steps in order.
Understand your partner's instructions and warnings in the kitchen (don't add the salt yet, don't touch that pan).
Explain why you can't or don't want to eat something, and ask what's wrong when your partner isn't eating.
Leave your partner a note saying there's nothing in the fridge and asking them to buy something for dinner.

task.goal: Decide on tonight's dinner and who cooks what: agree on one main dish and one side using what you have.

roles.a: Knows what's in the fridge and the cupboard (card A)
roles.b: Knows what you both had for lunch and what's on special at the supermarket (card B)

capstone.title: Cooking show for two
capstone.brief: Host a two-person cooking show: decide what to make by comparing two dishes, explain the steps, warn each other what not to do, deal with a small problem (something's missing: is there anything we can use instead?), and taste the result.
